title: HE BROUGHT ME TO HIS BANQUETING TABLE

lines.text: He brought me to His banqueting table,
And His banner over me is love } 2
His banner over me is love.
He set straight paths before my feet,
and His banner over me is love..
He broke the chains and He set me free...
He lifts me up into heavenly places...
I''m safe and secure in the Rock of all ages...
He is the Way, the Truth and the Life...
In Christ there is no condemnation...
I am my Beloved''s and He is mine...
